deep.reconstruction:
Problem. The page describes the moduli of a holomorphic sphere Σ ≅ P^1 with marked points K and an automorphism u of order 2 preserving K. Exactly one marked point is fixed: K = {P} ⊔ I. I is u-stable and contains no fixed point of u. The next page identifies the target as M_{0,5}, so |I| = 4. The aim is to describe the 'special locus' in M_{0,5}: 5-pointed genus-0 curves with an involution that fixes one marked point and swaps the other four in two pairs. Grothendieck then wants to study the induced map on fundamental groupoids, as part of the 1983 Teichmüller-tower programme.

Step (a). u has two fixed points. Call the marked one ∞ and the other 0. Then Σ∖{0,∞} is a torsor T_1 under C^*, with u acting as -1. Equivalently, Σ∖{0,∞} = L_1^* for a complex line L_1, and u is z ↦ -z.

Step (b). I is a pair of {±1}-orbits {±a}, {±b} in T_1. Grothendieck uses contracted powers of torsors, T^{∧n} := T^{⊗n} ≅ L_n^* with L_n = L_1^{⊗n}. Squaring sends I to an unordered pair of distinct points ξ = a², η = b² in T_2.

Step (c). The product e = ξ∧η = ξη ∈ T_4 trivialises T^{∧4}. This reduces the structure group of T from C^* to μ_4 ≅ Z/4. The pair {ξ,η} is then equivalent to the data e ∈ T_4 and s = ξ+η ∈ T_2. These are subject to the discriminant condition (ξ+η)² − 4ξη ≠ 0, which says ξ ≠ η. T_2 is reduced to {±1} by the choice ±√e.

Step (d), on the previous and next pages. Choose e_1 ∈ L_1 with e_1^{⊗4} = e. Then ξ = ξ_0 e_1², η = η_0 e_1² with ξ_0 η_0 = 1. Set μ = ξ_0 + η_0, so μ ≠ ±2 and ξ_0, η_0 are the roots of z² − μz + 1. I is recovered as the root set of z^4 − μz² + 1 = 0, i.e. I = {±a, ±a^{-1}}. Changing e_1 by a fourth root of unity ζ changes μ to ζ²μ, i.e. to ±μ.

Result. The e_1-rigidified moduli is the μ-line minus {±2} (Grothendieck writes P^1∖{0,±2,∞}). The true moduli is its quotient by μ ↦ −μ. Taking the quotient by u (w = z²) gives a 4-pointed line (0, ∞, ξ, η) with invariant λ = ξ/η + η/ξ + 2. So the locus is essentially a quotient/cover of M_{0,4}, mapping into M_{0,5}. The stated next step is to compare fundamental groupoids along this map, i.e. to obtain Galois/GT information from special loci.
errors: Excluding μ = 0 is not forced by the stated conditions. μ = 0 gives I = roots of z^4 + 1, a legitimate configuration with extra symmetry z ↦ iz. It is the orbifold point of the quotient μ ↦ −μ. Grothendieck probably removed it deliberately (an extra-automorphism stratum), but as written the rigidified moduli is A^1∖{±2}, not P^1∖{0,±2,∞}.
Minor: the notation ξ∧η for a product in a contracted power of a torsor is unusual and could be misread as an exterior product. It is consistent within the notes (e = ξ∧η = η∧ξ).

The last line ('ξ,η définissent une classe de C aux signes près') is elliptical. More precisely, after the ±√e reduction the pair {ξ,η} defines an unordered pair {ξ_0, 1/ξ_0} of complex numbers up to a simultaneous sign.

ideas.what: Describing a pointed P^1 with an involution via the C^*-torsor P^1∖{0,∞} and its contracted powers T^{∧n} ≅ L_1^{⊗n *}, with reduction of structure group to μ_4 given by e = ξη
ideas.modern_name: torsor/line-bundle description of cyclic-cover moduli; reduction of structure group

ideas.what: Explicit parametrisation of the locus in M_{0,5} of curves with an involution fixing one marked point and swapping the other four in pairs: I = roots of z^4 − μz² + 1, μ ≠ ±2, with residual action μ ↦ −μ
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme discusses curves with automorphisms in the Teichmüller tower in general terms

ideas.what: Studying the map from this special locus to M_{0,5} on fundamental groupoids, as a source of constraints for the Galois/GT action
ideas.modern_name: special loci and GT relations; Galois action on special loci

missed.claim: Grothendieck explicitly proposes using the one-dimensional automorphism stratum of M_{0,5} (stabiliser of type (12)(34) fixing the fifth point) and its map to M_{0,5} to study fundamental groupoids. This anticipates the 'special loci' approach to the Grothendieck–Teichmüller group, later developed by Schneps, Nakamura, Lochak and Collas–Maugeais. The mathematics itself is elementary, but this is documentary evidence of priority of the idea (1983).
missed.quote: Elle s'envoie dans la multiplicité M_{0,5} — il y a lieu de regarder l'effet sur les groupoïdes fondamentaux.
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Historical credit: it shows the special-loci strategy for GT was in Grothendieck's 1983 notes, predating the published special-loci literature. No new theorem.

deep.surprise_reason: The computation is a routine explicit parametrisation of an automorphism stratum of M_{0,5}. The only noteworthy point is the early (1983) intention to use such loci for fundamental-groupoid / Galois information, which was later developed independently.
transcription_corrections: Line 2: 'Un pt fixe exclu[?] dans K' is more likely 'Un pt fixe exactement dans K' (exactly one fixed point among the marked points).
'T_2 = T^{∧2}', 'T_4 = T^{∧4}' denote contracted powers of the torsor T = T_1 (not exterior powers).
The parenthetical under 'droite vectorielle' is hard to read; '(distinguée)' is uncertain and could be another word.
Last line: 'une classe de C aux signes près' probably refers to the pair {ξ_0, η_0} of complex numbers up to sign; the struck word at the end is illegible.
